sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Third Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend to the North-West Frontier Province Public Service Commission,
1978
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 9th October, 2002]
No. LEGIS:1(20)/73/7406, dated
9-10-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Public Service Commission (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once, and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 9th day of August, 2002.
